nodes.Name: trim
nodes.DocComment:
trim trailing zeros from number.
(They are meaningless; the decimal point is tracked
independent of the number of digits.)

nodes.Name: uintSize
nodes.DocComment:
Maximum shift that we can do in one pass without overflow.
A uint has 32 or 64 bits, and we have to be able to accommodate 9<<k.

nodes.Name: rightShift
nodes.DocComment: Binary shift right (/ 2) by k bits.  k <= maxShift to avoid overflow.

Fields.Name: cutoff
Fields.DocComment: minus one digit if original < a.

nodes.Name: prefixIsLessThan
nodes.DocComment: Is the leading prefix of b lexicographically less than s?

nodes.Name: leftShift
nodes.DocComment: Binary shift left (* 2) by k bits.  k <= maxShift to avoid overflow.

nodes.Name: shouldRoundUp
nodes.DocComment: If we chop a at nd digits, should we round up?

nodes.Name: Round
nodes.DocComment:
Round a to nd digits (or fewer).
If nd is zero, it means we're rounding
just to the left of the digits, as in
0.09 -> 0.1.

nodes.Name: RoundDown
nodes.DocComment: Round a down to nd digits (or fewer).

nodes.Name: RoundUp
nodes.DocComment: Round a up to nd digits (or fewer).

nodes.Name: RoundedInteger
nodes.DocComment:
Extract integer part, rounded appropriately.
No guarantees about overflow.
